# Sersan

> AI-powered software engineering for fintech, SaaS, and regulated tech. Built to run at 3am.

Sersan is a London-registered, EU-operating engineering consultancy founded by Alessandro Serratt (CEO, commercial generalist) and Michele Sanna (CPTO, PhD applied mathematics, ex-Revolut / JPMorgan / Deloitte / Brevan Howard / Accenture). We design, build, and operate the software, the AI layer, and what runs in production — same people start-to-finish.

## What we do

- **Technical audits** — one-week diagnostic of your product, systems, data, and manual work. Scored map of what to build, fix, and ship next. From £15K.
- **Applied AI (LLM / RAG)** — production AI systems, not demos. Multi-head retrieval, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, monitoring.
- **ML & Data Engineering** — pipelines, feature stores, MLOps, model lifecycle.
- **Custom software engineering** — TypeScript / Python / Go / Rust depending on what's appropriate. We don't ship to a stack religion.
- **Fractional CTO / CPTO** — ongoing senior steering from £8K/month, no minimum term.
- **AI/IoT for agrivoltaics** — vertical specialization in solar-agriculture monitoring with edge inference.

## How we work

- Weekly scope. No multi-year retainers.
- Engagements from £15K. Fractional from £8K/month, no minimum term.
- Same senior people from audit through operate. If it breaks at 3am, we wake up.
- Compliance baked in (EU AI Act, DORA, GDPR, ISO 27001), not bolted on.

## What we refuse

- Projects under £15K — wrong fit, here's who's better.
- Junior developers staffed on your project.
- Three-month scoping phases before anyone writes code.
- "AI strategy" decks without production deliverables.

## Where we are

- London (registered)
- EU-operating
- Reply within 1 business day
